phase_1.title: Phase 1 · Challenger 2 Firing Solenoid & Primer Ignition
phase_1.description: Closing the crew firing circuit energizes the breech firing pin, igniting the primary propellant charge inside the sealed 120mm L30A1 Rifled Tank Gun (CHARM 3 / HESH) chamber.

phase_2.title: Phase 2 · 670 MPa Chamber Deflagration
phase_2.description: Rapid propellant burn drives chamber pressure to 670 MPa against the heavy locked breechblock while accelerating the heavy projectile.

phase_3.title: Phase 3 · 6600 mm Ordnance Acceleration
phase_3.description: Expanding gases accelerate the 120mm L30A1 Rifled Tank Gun (CHARM 3 / HESH) round along the 6600 mm barrel up to 1650 m/s (11,400,000 J).

phase_4.title: Phase 4 · Bore Clearance & Muzzle Blast
phase_4.description: The projectile clears the muzzle crown cleanly for engagements out to 5000 m while bore gases evacuate safely away from the crew.

phase_5.title: Phase 5 · Hydropneumatic Recoil Absorption
phase_5.description: Recoil cylinders absorb 27900 N-s of impulse smoothly across the cradle while transferring residual load into the chassis.

phase_6.title: Phase 6 · Breech Opening & Stub Extraction
phase_6.description: During battery runout, hydropneumatic recoil cylinders damp main-gun impulse and semi-automatically open the sliding breech, ejecting the spent base stub cleanly into the deflector bin.

phase_7.title: Phase 7 · Munition Ramming & Battery Lock
phase_7.description: The next 120mm L30A1 Rifled Tank Gun (CHARM 3 / HESH) round seats into the chamber and locks the breechblock back into firing readiness.

zh.headline: 英国挑战者 2（FV4034）1:1 主战坦克：1998 年机械传奇与工程剖析
zh.deck: 英国挑战者 2（FV4034）是当代北约唯一采用 120mm 线膛主炮的现役主战坦克：L30A1 高压线膛炮既能借助滑环发射高速脱壳穿甲弹，也能精准远射 HESH 碎甲弹；二代“多切斯特”乔巴姆复合装甲赋予其传奇级正面抗毁力。 本馆以 1:1 真实工程比例重现其 20 大核心构件与完整工作循环。

acts.title: 时代召唤与研发立项：Challenger 2 的诞生背景
paragraphs: 1998 年问世的 英国挑战者 2（FV4034）1:1 主战坦克 由英国维克斯防务 / BAE 系统公司主导研制，定位为经典的重装甲线膛炮主战坦克（1:1 真实尺度）。挑战者 2 继承了英国 1991 年海湾战争中挑战者 1 创下的 4.7 公里远距坦克直瞄击毁纪录，车内更标配经典的英军战地煮沸壶（Boiling Vessel）。
英国挑战者 2（FV4034）是当代北约唯一采用 120mm 线膛主炮的现役主战坦克：L30A1 高压线膛炮既能借助滑环发射高速脱壳穿甲弹，也能精准远射 HESH 碎甲弹；二代“多切斯特”乔巴姆复合装甲赋予其传奇级正面抗毁力。 整件装备总长 11,550 mm（含炮管向前 · 车体 8,327 mm）、空重 64000 kg，成为同期重装坦克领域最具辨识度的里程碑之一。
acts.audioScript: 第一幕，时代起源。1998 年，英国维克斯防务 / BAE 系统公司推出了划时代的英国挑战者 2（FV4034）1:1 主战坦克。挑战者 2 继承了英国 1991 年海湾战争中挑战者 1 创下的 4.7 公里远距坦克直瞄击毁纪录，车内更标配经典的英军战地煮沸壶（Boiling Vessel）。 它的核心设计聚焦于L30A1 120mm L/55 36 条膛线主炮，兼容滑环穿甲弹与 HESH 碎甲弹，奠定了其在重装坦克发展史中的经典地位。
acts.focusPartLabel: 主战坦克复合装甲炮塔壳体

acts.title: 核心机械构造与闭锁奥秘
paragraphs: 英国挑战者 2（FV4034）1:1 主战坦克 的机械灵魂在于其「人工分装式药包闭气立楔炮闩 · 唯一现役北约 120mm 线膛主炮」结构体系。在发射工作循环中，主炮发射后液压驻退复进机吸收巨额炮膛后坐并自动开闩抛壳待装，将高压能量精确约束于承力框架之内。
制造工艺方面，关键承力件采用北约三色低红外涂装复合装甲钢精加工而成。二代 Dorchester 乔巴姆复合装甲炮塔与分体式阻燃药包隔离筒，在严苛实战条件下依然保持顺畅节拍与长期尺寸稳定性。
acts.audioScript: 第二幕，核心机械原理。英国挑战者 2（FV4034）1:1 主战坦克 采用人工分装式药包闭气立楔炮闩 · 唯一现役北约 120mm 线膛主炮。在每个击发周期中，主炮发射后液压驻退复进机吸收巨额炮膛后坐并自动开闩抛壳待装。借助北约三色低红外涂装复合装甲钢工艺与高强度配合，实现了二代 Dorchester 乔巴姆复合装甲炮塔与分体式阻燃药包隔离筒。
acts.focusPartLabel: 重型立楔/螺式主炮炮闩

acts.title: 弹道性能、内膛工艺与实战效能
paragraphs: 该平台配用 120mm L30A1 Rifled Tank Gun (CHARM 3 / HESH) 弹药规格与 6,600 mm（120mm L/55 36 条右旋膛线 · 1:18 倍径缠距），最高工作膛压约 670 MPa，可赋予弹头 1650 m/s 的出膛初速与 11,400,000 J 动能，有效作用距离达 5000 米。
内膛技术特点方面，120mm L30A1 电渣重熔 36 条线膛炮管，采用滑动闭气环发射脱壳穿甲弹与碎甲弹（HESH）。同时，六对液气独立悬挂（Hydrogas）大幅降低高速越野车体俯仰角，令其在 7 发/分（分装人工装填） 的节奏下兼具精准控制与可靠输出。
acts.audioScript: 第三幕，弹道与实战表现。配备 6600 毫米身管与 120mm L30A1 Rifled Tank Gun (CHARM 3 / HESH) 口径，英国挑战者 2（FV4034）1:1 主战坦克 实现了每秒 1650 米的初速与 5000 米有效射程。120mm L30A1 电渣重熔 36 条线膛炮管，采用滑动闭气环发射脱壳穿甲弹与碎甲弹（HESH），展现了卓越的工程平衡。

acts.title: 人机工效、供弹哲学与百年遗产
paragraphs: 围绕 49 发容量的尾舱隔爆泄压主炮弹药架与 1850 mm 膛轴设计，英国挑战者 2（FV4034）1:1 主战坦克 将单发后坐冲量控制在 27900 N·s 水平。Perkins CV12 1,200 马力 V12 柴油机与车长周视热像仪（TOGS II）。
如今在数字兵器库 3D 百年展厅（BAY-95）中，您可以随时通过三轴剖视、100% 爆炸视图与实时运动学滑块，零距离拆解这座跨越时代的机械工程杰作。
acts.audioScript: 第四幕，百年遗产。凭借 49 发容量的尾舱隔爆泄压主炮弹药架与出色的整体工效，Perkins CV12 1,200 马力 V12 柴油机与车长周视热像仪（TOGS II）。欢迎在 BAY-95 展位亲手切开剖面、逐件拆解，感受 英国挑战者 2（FV4034）1:1 主战坦克 的机械魅力。

acts.title: Origins & Operational Mandate of the Challenger 2
paragraphs: Introduced in 1998 by Vickers Defence Systems / BAE Systems in United Kingdom, the BAE Challenger 2 (FV4034) Main Battle Tank emerged as a defining Rifled-Gun Heavy Main Battle Tank (1:1 Scale). Continuing the lineage of Challenger 1’s 4.7 km long-range kill in 1991, Challenger 2 retains a famed built-in crew Boiling Vessel alongside its heavily armored Dorchester turret.

Uniquely among modern NATO main battle tanks, the British FV4034 Challenger 2 retains a 120mm L30A1 rifled main gun capable of firing both slipping-obturator APFSDS darts and long-range HESH shells behind second-generation Dorchester Chobham composite armor. Measuring 11,550 mm (gun forward · 8,327 mm hull) at an unloaded weight of 64000 kg, it reshaped expectations across the 1:1 Main Battle Tank class.
acts.audioScript: Act One: Historical Origins. In 1998, Vickers Defence Systems / BAE Systems of United Kingdom introduced the BAE Challenger 2 (FV4034) Main Battle Tank. Continuing the lineage of Challenger 1’s 4.7 km long-range kill in 1991, Challenger 2 retains a famed built-in crew Boiling Vessel alongside its heavily armored Dorchester turret. Anchored by its hallmark design trait — 120mm L30A1 L/55 36-groove rifled gun fires both slip-ring APFSDS and HESH — it quickly established an enduring engineering benchmark.

acts.title: Core Operating Architecture & Lockup Mechanics
paragraphs: At the mechanical heart of the BAE Challenger 2 (FV4034) Main Battle Tank sits its Manual Two-Piece Bag-Charge Split-Block Breech · Unique NATO 120mm Rifled Gun. Throughout every firing cycle, hydropneumatic recoil cylinders damp main-gun impulse and semi-automatically open the sliding breech, containing 670 MPa of operating pressure safely.

Constructed in NATO three-tone low-IR composite armor steel, the assembly achieves durable field tolerances. Notably, Second-generation Dorchester Chobham armor with armored propellant charge bins, sustaining dependable operation under severe environmental stress.
acts.audioScript: Act Two: Core Mechanical Architecture. The BAE Challenger 2 (FV4034) Main Battle Tank relies on Manual Two-Piece Bag-Charge Split-Block Breech · Unique NATO 120mm Rifled Gun. During each cycle, hydropneumatic recoil cylinders damp main-gun impulse and semi-automatically open the sliding breech. Machined from NATO three-tone low-IR composite armor steel, it delivers standout engineering reliability: Second-generation Dorchester Chobham armor with armored propellant charge bins.

acts.title: Ballistic Performance, Bore Craft & Range Reach
paragraphs: Chambered for 120mm L30A1 Rifled Tank Gun (CHARM 3 / HESH) with 6,600 mm (120mm L/55 36-Groove RH Rifled · 1:18 Calibers), the BAE Challenger 2 (FV4034) Main Battle Tank develops 1650 m/s muzzle velocity and 11,400,000 J of kinetic energy for effective engagement out to 5000 meters.

Internally, 120mm L30A1 electro-slag-refined 36-groove rifled tube firing slip-ring APFSDS and HESH rounds. Combined with its 7 RPM (manual two-piece load) tempo, Hydrogas hydropneumatic suspension cushions cross-country hull pitch, delivering disciplined accuracy across demanding field conditions.
acts.audioScript: Act Three: Ballistic Performance. Driving 120mm L30A1 Rifled Tank Gun (CHARM 3 / HESH) through its 6600 millimeter bore, the BAE Challenger 2 (FV4034) Main Battle Tank achieves 1650 meters per second and 5000 meters of effective reach. 120mm L30A1 electro-slag-refined 36-groove rifled tube firing slip-ring APFSDS and HESH rounds.

Now archived in Digital Armory 3D Centennial Gallery (BAY-95), all 20 interactive assemblies can be sectioned live along three axes, exploded to 100%, and inspected part by part.
